clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements for cinder for use as aggregates in lime concrete.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: 2. General —  Cinder aggregates shall be well-burnt furnace residue obtained from furnaces using only coal as fuel. It shall be clean and free from clay, dirt, wood ash or other deleterious matter.

clauses.title: Classes
clauses.text: 3. Classes  — a) Class A - for general purposes b) Class B - for interior work not exposed to damp conditions, and c) Class C -  for precast blocks.

clauses.title: Grading
clauses.text: 4. Grading — IS Sieve Percentage Designation Passing 10- mm 100 4.75- mm 80 2.36- mm 60 1.18- mm 40 600- micron 30 300- micron 25 150- micron 16

clauses.title: Sulphate Content
clauses.text: 5.1 Sulphate Content — Shall not exceed  1 percent when expressed as sulphur trioxide.

clauses.title: Loss on ignition
clauses.text: 5.2 Loss on ignition — Shall not exceed 10 percent for class A, 20 percent for class B and 25 percent for Class C. SUMMARY OF IS 2686 : 1977 CINDER AS FINE AGGREGATES FOR USE IN LIME CONCRETE (First Revision) For detailed information, refer to IS 2686 :1977 Specification for cinder as fine  aggregates for use in lime concrete(first revision). Note —  For methods of tests, refer to  Appendices A and B of the standard.
